saw_lines: Shoppers buy from an online pharmacy only once they trust it is licensed, then reorder items without comparing prices again.
So the license number has to sit next to the first product, because a first-time buyer needs trust before the price.
Your 241 Google creatives are 6 videos, 19 text ads and 15 image ads, so the next batch should lead with the AEMPS license number your site already shows.
ads_1: Google text ads leading with the AEMPS license number and fast reorders
